b: Before I started, I thought the hardest parts would be finding customers, managing cash flow, and dealing with competition. Those are definitely tough, but honestly, the things that catch me off guard most are the day-to-day mental hurdles—wearing 10 different hats before noon, constantly second-guessing pricing, and feeling like you can never truly "clock out" even when you're off the clock.
Lately, I’ve been trying to step back and work on the business instead of just in it, and it got me thinking about how much trial-and-error goes into figuring this stuff out.
